text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At a school assembly, Light Hello explains our goals for the Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our vision is a concert where all students get a chance to sing, and all fans get a chance to convey the emotions they feel for their favorite runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon steps in to bolster our case. She prods the students to think what else, other than gratitude, they want to convey to their fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both runners and fans harbor selfish desires. The passion generated when those desires collide could open the door to new possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The students seem convinced—one by one, hands go up across the room, signaling a desire to participate.
